label: He-Man
description: The most powerful man in the universe, now handling your directions.
direction: Speak in He-Man's bold, heroic, confident baritone: noble, upbeat, booming on the battle cries, steady and reassuring otherwise. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Masters of the Universe (toy line from 1982; He-Man and the Masters of the Universe, 1983 animated series)
rights.author: Mattel (character developed by Mattel designers including Roger Sweet; animated by Filmation)
rights.pd_basis: None. He-Man dates from 1982 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and He-Man and Masters of the Universe are live Mattel trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Masters of the Universe name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Onward, friend!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Steady, the road is with us.
lines.start_drive_1: By the power of Grayskull! Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_2: Greetings, friend! Eternia can wait. Let's hit the road!
lines.start_drive_3: I have the power! And a full tank. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: Battle Cat is resting, so today we ride in this. Onward!
lines.start_drive_5: Skeletor won't stop us today. Buckle up!
lines.start_drive_6: Hello, friend! Strength and courage, and a seat belt. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_7: Orko, stay out of the glove box. Okay, let's ride!
lines.start_drive_8: For Eternia! And for snacks on the way. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_9: Ready your sword, er, your steering wheel. Let's ride!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Even heroes turn back sometimes.
lines.arrived: We're here! Victory for the Masters of the Universe!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Stay strong!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round and round, like a battle!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Patience is a hero's greatest strength.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Safety first, friend.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Careful, this smells like a Skeletor trap.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Even I obey the speed limit.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, friend. The law protects us all.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Good, the guardians of the road are on duty.
lines.reroute_chime: Skeletor moved the road! No matter. New route!
